# Sunstar Group

> > Sunstar Group is a Japanese-heritage global manufacturer of consumer and professional oral care products, health and beauty items, and industrial adhesives and materials.

With over 90 years of research and innovation, Sunstar operates across multiple business divisions including consumer oral care (GUM, Butler, Ora2), professional dental solutions, health and beauty products, and industrial adhesives and sealants for automotive and living environment applications. The company maintains a strong global presence with operations across Japan, Europe, and the U.S.A.

## Key Topics

- Oral Care (GUM, Butler, Ora2)
- Adhesives & Sealants
- Automotive Materials
- Professional Dental Solutions
- Consumer Health & Beauty
- Chemical Division
- Material Core Division
- Air Purification Technology
- Manufacturing Solutions
- Global Operations
- Research & Innovation
- Photocatalytic Technology
- Sunstar Engineering

## Consumer Health, Beauty & Safety

- [Health Food and Beauty – Consumer Business| Sunstar Group](https://www.sunstar.com/brands/consumer-health-beauty): Sunstar's health food and beauty products including KENKODOJO and Equitance.
- [Chemical and Material Core | Sunstar Group](https://www.sunstar.com/brands/consumer-safety-mobility): Sunstar's adhesives, sealants, and consumer safety products for automotive.

## Industrial Adhesives & Materials

- [Chemical and Material Core | Sunstar Group](https://www.sunstar.com/consumer-living-environment): Sunstar's adhesives and home care products for living environments.
- [Chemical and Material Core | Sunstar Group](https://www.sunstar.com/brands/professional-safety-mobility): Professional adhesives and sealants for automotive manufacturing solutions.
- [Chemical and Material Core | Sunstar Group](https://www.sunstar.com/brands/professional-living-environment): Professional living environment products with adhesives and air purification.
